**`dump(rows) -> str`**
- Quotes a field only when it contains `,`, `"`, `\n`, or `\r`; embedded `"` is written as `""`
- Joins fields with `,`, rows with `\r\n`, and terminates the last row with `\r\n` (empty input list → `""`)
- Raises `ValueError` when `rows` isn't a list/tuple, when a row isn't a list/tuple, or when a field isn't a `str`
- Spec examples verified: `dump([["a,b"]]) == '"a,b"\r\n'`, `dump([["a", "b"]]) == 'a,b\r\n'`

**`load(text) -> str -> list`**
- Hand-rolled character parser (no `csv` module) that handles quoted fields with `""` escapes, embedded newlines/CRs, and empty fields
- Raises `ValueError` on malformed input: unterminated quotes, lone CR/LF, non-CRLF row separators, garbage after a closing quote, non-`str` input
- Missing *final* CRLF is accepted, per RFC 4180 ("the last record may or may not be followed by a final line break")

**Round-trip** verified with targeted nasty cases (`""`, `"`, `""`, `a,b`, `a"b`, `\r`, `\n`, `\r\n`-containing fields, empty rows, 1000-char fields) plus a 10,000-case random fuzz over the alphabet `ab," \t\r\n` — `load(dump(rows)) == rows` held for every case with rows of one or more fields.
